name: HYDRA-UMC-SDK
build: Functional JSON Schema v1 contracts, a real first OpenAPI v1 slice for HYDRA-UMC-SERVER's own HTTP surface, plus real, tested Python, Go, TypeScript and Rust reference clients and conformance fixtures.
notes: The common contract and conformance boundary for services, UIs, CM5 adapters and URTC. Provides v1 JSON Schema, a Python reference validator and conformance fixtures, plus a real, automatic compatibility matrix (tools/verify_contract_matrix.py) between the published schemas and the validator - found and fixed a real gap where the ProjectManifest (hydra-umc.project.json) contract had no validator entry at all. Go, TypeScript and Rust reference clients (clients/go, clients/typescript, clients/rust) now compile and enforce the real published schemas directly through a real Draft 2020-12 validator library per language, each with its own passing test suite against the shared conformance fixtures; the CI baseline now actually discovers and exercises all three (their manifests live under clients/, not the repository root). contracts/openapi/v1/server.openapi.json is a real, hand-verified OpenAPI 3.1 description of HYDRA-UMC-SERVER's discovery/auth/fleet/command routes (docs/API_DESIGN.md's own committed 'OpenAPI source', not a placeholder), gated by a new dependency-free tools/verify_openapi.py now wired into both build-test and, alongside verify_contract_matrix.py itself, this repository's real CI workflow for the first time. `BridgeJob`'s direct public constructor now validates `parameters` is a real mapping before using it, matching the guard `job_from_dict()` already had (REV-009) - every real construction path across the ecosystem's bridges fails the same clean way now. Package publication remains a release gate.
